label: Fontina
note: Only the Aosta Valley Fontina is PDO (EU 1996); other Italian and foreign fontina-style cheeses differ. A 2023 amendment created separate names for alpeggio and long-aged versions.

about.text: Fontina is a cow cheese from Italy, first made in the Aosta Valley, where the PDO version must be made from raw milk of a single milking.
